title: Windy control-surface manifest, v1
$comment: ADR-060 §3.1/§4: the generative source every bilingual surface is woven from. First citizen: windytalk contracts/control.mcp.v1.json rev.6 (validates as-is; fields the doctrine added since — doctrine, product, class — are optional here and surfaced as WARNINGS by loom/validate.py, becoming required in manifest v2). Change control: additive → minor via PR; breaking → new v2 file and tell Grant.

doctrine.$comment: Which doctrine version this surface complies with (ADR-060 §8.6). Optional in v1 (Talk rev.6 predates it); validator warns when absent.

product.$comment: Dev-name of the owning repo, e.g. windy-pro, windytalk. Validator warns when absent.

class.$comment: ADR-060 §2 platform class. Validator warns when absent.

mcp_protocol.$comment: MCP protocol revision the generated server speaks, e.g. 2025-06-18.

tier.$comment: ADR-060 §3.5 knob danger tier. Talk vocabulary, verbatim.

description.$comment: Utterance-first grandma-English — what the model reads AND what Grant reviews. 40-char floor rejects lazy stubs; utterance-firstness itself is reviewed by humans, not machines.

inputSchema.$comment: JSON Schema for the tool's arguments. The generator passes it through to both transports untouched.

returns.$comment: JSON Schema for the tool's result. Optional but strongly encouraged — conformance asserts against it when present.

band_floor.$comment: Minimum caller band that DISCOVERS this tool (ADR-060 §3.5 band-filtered discovery). Default when absent: USER for auto_allow reads, TRUSTED for mutations — pinned in schema/band-ei-mapping.v1.json.

$governance_note: Top-level governance blocks (security, tiers, recovery_coordinator, resurrection, telemetry, …) are allowed and encouraged — Talk rev.6 carries eight of them. They are contract-specific and validated by eye + conformance cases, not by this schema.
